model.name: google/gemini-3.8-flash
model.about: Google: Gemini 3.8 Flash, through OpenRouter at $0.75 in and $3.75 out per million tokens.

answers.sql: SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS JURISDICTION_NAME, j.JUR_CD1 AS JURISDICTION_CODE, COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS ALERT_COUNT FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1 ORDER BY ALERT_COUNT DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31' AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE

SELECT ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K, ctg.DSPLY_NM AS CMPLT_CTG_DSPLY_NM, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS COMPLAINT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K, ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY COMPLAINT_CNT DESC

SELECT coalesce(c.iso_alph_cd1, f.ccy_cd1) AS ccy_cd, c.ccy_nm, f.ccy_pair_cd1, round(avg(coalesce(f.avrg_rt, f.mid_rt)), 6) AS avg_fx_rate FROM bank_dwh.f_fx_rt_d AS f INNER JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.d_ccy AS c ON f.ccy_k = c.ccy_k WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025 GROUP BY coalesce(c.iso_alph_cd1, f.ccy_cd1), c.ccy_nm, f.ccy_pair_cd1 ORDER BY ccy_cd, f.ccy_pair_cd1

SELECT f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_MKT_VAL_AMT, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_NAV_AMT FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
  da.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT da.BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT da
WHERE da.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND da.OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  da.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY
  da.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY b.CTY_NM;
SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE (c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD' OR f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD') AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS cust_sgmnt_cd1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS declined_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT ctg.DSPLY_NM AS cmplt_ctg_nm, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_cmplt_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY escalated_cmplt_cnt DESC

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT prd.DSPLY_NM AS ln_prd_nm, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS tot_otstn_prncp_amt FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f ON prd.LN_PRD_K = f.LN_PRD_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS DISTINCT_SME_CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND UPPER(c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1) = 'SME'

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_txn_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC) AS rnk FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM) SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_count FROM branch_txn_counts WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS CUST_BUS_ID, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMT FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMT DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(d.iso_alph_cd1, f.ccy_cd1) AS currency_code, SUM(f.orgnl_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS f JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.d_ccy AS d ON f.ccy_k = d.ccy_k WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(d.iso_alph_cd1, f.ccy_cd1) ORDER BY currency_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT w.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL) AND c.CUST_K IN (SELECT a.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY yr
SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE ORDER BY branch_name;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_transfer_amount, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY total_transfer_amount DESC

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS JURISDICTION_NAME, j.JUR_CD1 AS JURISDICTION_CODE, COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS AML_ALERT_COUNT FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1 ORDER BY AML_ALERT_COUNT DESC

SELECT b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID AS BR_BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM AS BR_DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS ATM_TXN_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY ATM_TXN_CNT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dspt_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K, ctg.DSPLY_NM AS CMPLT_CTG_NM, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS CMPLT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K, ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY CMPLT_CNT DESC

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS ccy_cd, c.CCY_NM AS ccy_nm, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1 AS ccy_pair_cd, AVG(COALESCE(f.AVRG_RT, f.MID_RT)) AS avg_daily_fx_rt FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, c.CCY_NM, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1 ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1

SELECT f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_val, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_net_asset_val FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1;
-- Data modification (DELETE) operations are not supported in this read-only interface.

SELECT
  da.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS acct_typ_cd1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT da.BUS_ID) AS opnd_acct_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT AS da
WHERE da.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND da.OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  da.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY
  da.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE (c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD' OR f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD') AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND (EFF_FRM_DT IS NULL OR EFF_FRM_DT <= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS declined_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT ctg.DSPLY_NM AS cmplt_ctg_nm, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS esclt_cmplt_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY esclt_cmplt_cnt DESC, ctg.DSPLY_NM ASC;
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(alrt.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS alrt INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS jur ON alrt.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt ON alrt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE alrt.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS DISTINCT_SME_CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND UPPER(c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1) = 'SME'

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b
        ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        b.RGN_CD1,
        b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY
    region_code,
    branch_name;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_trf_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT w.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_w ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt_w.DT_K WHERE dt_w.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL) AND c.CUST_K IN (SELECT a.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_a ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt_a.DT_K WHERE dt_a.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY branch_name;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_volume FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY total_wire_volume DESC

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust.BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS cust WHERE cust.IS_CURR = TRUE AND cust.IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS JURISDICTION_NAME, j.JUR_CD1 AS JURISDICTION_CODE, COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS AML_ALERT_COUNT FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1 ORDER BY AML_ALERT_COUNT DESC

SELECT b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31' AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K, ctg.DSPLY_NM AS CMPLT_CTG_DSPLY_NM, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS COMPLAINT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K, ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY COMPLAINT_CNT DESC

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, c.CCY_NM AS currency_name, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1 AS currency_pair, AVG(COALESCE(f.AVRG_RT, f.MID_RT)) AS avg_daily_fx_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1), c.CCY_NM, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1 ORDER BY currency_code, currency_pair

SELECT f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_MKT_VAL_AMT, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_NET_ASST_VAL_AMT FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1;
SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS ACCT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1 ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY br.CTY_NM ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC, branch_city ASC;
SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE (c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD' OR f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD') AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS declined_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY
  ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS DISTINCT_SME_CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND UPPER(c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1) = 'SME'

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.BR_K,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1
      ORDER BY COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b
    ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.RGN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    b.RGN_CD1,
    b.BR_K,
    b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  branch_name,
  atm_transaction_count
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f_wr_trF.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, SUM(f_wr_trF.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f_wr_trf INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f_wr_trf.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY currency_code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT w.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL) AND c.CUST_K IN (SELECT a.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS cal_yr_nbr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY branch_name;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, COUNT(*) AS trf_cnt, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS ttl_orgnl_amt, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS ttl_stlm_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY ccy_cd
